preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or marketingWallet address
Contract must have accumulated tax tokens (balanceOf(address(this)) > 0)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or marketingWallet, call getAllTaxes() function to transfer all accumulated tax tokens to marketingWallet as ETH. The function swaps contract's token balance for ETH and sends it to marketingWallet without any limits. Ensure the contract has accumulated tax tokens from previous transactions first.
